construct.diagnosis_or_process: Chunk-and-check communication for complex medical information
construct.mechanism: Chunk-and-check reduces cognitive load by presenting a small amount of information at a time and confirming comprehension before moving to the next segment. It differs from a single end-of-visit yes/no check because misunderstanding is identified and corrected iteratively.
construct.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

second_answer_attack.strongest_alternative: Repeat the complete plan more slowly and ask for a single end-of-visit confirmation.
second_answer_attack.resolution: Chunk-and-check is distinct because it limits each information unit and verifies comprehension before adding the next unit. Repetition without iterative verification leaves hidden misunderstanding undetected.
